method.purpose: Bounded buyer-wants and purchase-objection extraction for website and SEO services.
method.sample_target: 20 substantive public customer reviews or interview-style reviews across local and national providers.
method.selection_rule: Prefer reviews with a named role or business type, project scope, spend band or pricing detail, concrete value or friction, and a recommendation or clear decision signal.
method.caveat: These are customer-reported statements on public review platforms. Outcomes, spend, and causal claims were not independently verified and are not representative prevalence estimates.

records.project_scope: Rebuilt a website from old content, rewrote positioning, designed pages, and added SEO.
records.buyer_job: Recover rankings and leads while making the medical site clearer for prospective patients.
valued: website and SEO work tied to inquiries
records.problem_or_friction: No material dislike reported.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported increased traffic, leads, website responses, and inquiries about procedures.
records.recommendation: Highly recommends the provider for website and SEO work.

records.project_scope: Content, on-page SEO, and off-page SEO to improve organic leads and website visits; cleaned up duplicate content from a previous designer.
records.buyer_job: Create a dependable organic lead source beyond referrals.
records.problem_or_friction: No material dislike reported.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported increased calls and new patients after duplicate-content cleanup and ranking improvements.
records.recommendation: Would highly recommend and tells buyers to listen to the provider's recommendations.

records.project_scope: Technical error cleanup followed by SEO; later addressed site speed, image display, and product-photo labeling.
records.buyer_job: Remove technical blockers and rank for product-related searches.
valued: quick solutions to large or small issues
records.problem_or_friction: Reviewer wished for more formal, specific, measurable, and time-bound goals at the outset.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported first-page or top-three rankings, approximately 320% organic-traffic growth over about ten months, and more new-client business.
records.recommendation: Repeatedly recommends the provider, with the qualification that goal-setting should start more formally.

reviewer.client_type: small business; exact industry not stated

records.spend_band: unknown; reviewer explicitly describes upfront pricing as high for a small business
records.project_scope: Google Maps optimization, review guidance, local SEO, and qualified-lead targeting.
records.buyer_job: Gain local visibility and reduce low-quality inquiries.
records.problem_or_friction: Upfront price felt like a real hurdle; detailed reports could be overwhelming.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported visibility in nearby areas, better trust, and more serious booking-ready leads.
records.recommendation: Positive after deciding the ROI justified the price.
records.quote_excerpt: High Upfront Cost, but ROI Makes It Worth It

records.project_scope: Technical and content work aimed at site speed, navigation, conversion points, and relevant content.
records.buyer_job: Turn existing visitors into inquiries instead of buying traffic alone.
valued: connected system rather than isolated tasks
records.problem_or_friction: Content revisions could take longer than expected, slowing quick changes.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported a faster, cleaner site and a steady increase in form submissions and calls.
records.recommendation: Positive, with turnaround on revisions as the main improvement request.

records.spend_band: free professional Wordpress website advertised; reviewer did not state total spend
records.project_scope: Setup, design, and basic structure of a professional site with step-by-step guidance.
records.buyer_job: Get online without technical expertise or a large budget.
records.problem_or_friction: Customization was limited and advanced changes might require time or an upgrade.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported being online quickly enough to focus on core work.
records.recommendation: Recommends for beginners or small projects, with clear requirements and patience.

records.spend_band: unknown; reviewer says they paid despite the service being marketed as free
records.project_scope: Wordpress website build with revisions and support.
records.buyer_job: Receive a usable business website on the advertised free-service model.
records.problem_or_friction: Reviewer alleged four months of delays, poor communication, unusable restrictions, incorrect login information, and a disputed refund.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer said the final site lacked hyperlinks and flexible image or content editing and was effectively unusable.
records.recommendation: Strongly advises against the provider.
records.causality_status: allegation reported by reviewer; not independently verified

records.project_scope: SEO services; website creation and optimization are also mentioned.
records.buyer_job: Improve ranking and organic visibility after trying other SEO companies.
valued: results visible in ranking and traffic
records.problem_or_friction: No material dislike reported.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer said rankings and organic traffic improved versus previous providers.
records.recommendation: Highly recommends the provider.

records.segment: New York-based SEO and web-development agency serving small businesses
records.spend_band: $50,000 to $199,999 band; interview states $50,000 invested so far
records.project_scope: Created and updated website, web pages, blogs, and a PR campaign; ongoing SEO and web development since July 2024.
records.buyer_job: Update the site and content while gaining measurable search visibility.
valued: showing what was done and results after 30 days
records.problem_or_friction: Reviewer wanted more training on using the content-editing dashboard.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported 45 ranked keywords, 129 articles, over 500,000 impressions after eight months, and 2,681 clicks.
records.recommendation: Positive; value signal is transparency and responsiveness, with dashboard training as a gap.
records.evidence_type: Clutch verified online review with interview-style questions
records.quote_excerpt: The team always replies to me right away.

records.spend_band: less than $10,000; reviewer states $179 upfront plus a proposed $29/month
records.project_scope: Promised fixes to SEO issues on the website.
records.buyer_job: Buy a very low-cost fix package for existing SEO problems.
records.problem_or_friction: Reviewer says price drove selection, then the provider stopped communicating after payment and performed no work.
records.reported_outcome: No deliverables or measurable outcome reported.
records.recommendation: Strongly advises against the provider and labels the experience a scam.
records.quote_excerpt: They did nothing — took my money and ran.

records.project_scope: New Wordpress website with e-commerce features, ongoing SEO, website development, and social media support.
records.buyer_job: Leave an unsatisfactory host, launch a basic site within about two months, and add commerce.
records.problem_or_friction: No material dislike reported.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported more new customers.
records.recommendation: Positive; reviewer says the provider does what it says.
records.quote_excerpt: They do what they say they will do.

records.project_scope: SEO intended to generate website leads.
records.buyer_job: Generate leads without losing the existing site.
records.problem_or_friction: Reviewer alleges zero leads, deletion or loss of the whole site, blame over keyword choices, and the need to rebuild.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported no leads after six months and additional rebuilding cost.
records.recommendation: Would not recommend.
records.causality_status: allegation reported by reviewer; not independently verified

records.segment: regional SEO, web, and paid-search provider
records.spend_band: $10,000 to $49,999; interview states CAD $10,000 website, CAD $1,200/month ongoing, and about CAD $6,000 in updates
records.project_scope: Website rebuild, content, ongoing digital presence monitoring, PPC campaigns, and weekly Google Ads budget planning.
records.buyer_job: Replace inconsistent marketing performance with a stable, measurable program.
records.problem_or_friction: Reviewer wanted the provider to be more proactive on SEO, with more milestone meetings and expectation-setting.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported buying four vehicles and 10% sales growth since engagement.
records.recommendation: Positive but advises buyers to set goals and milestones and expect SEO to be ongoing.
records.quote_excerpt: the team always delivers on time

records.segment: national website design and development agency

records.buyer_job: Create a fast, mobile-responsive site that converts and is easy to maintain.
valued: technical performance paired with visual design
records.problem_or_friction: No major complaint; one reviewer wanted user guides earlier.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported better loading speed, mobile responsiveness, lower bounce rate, higher PageSpeed, longer sessions, and more lead conversions.
records.recommendation: Positive; provider selected partly because pricing fit the budget and value looked good.
records.quote_excerpt: quickly resolve issues and stay engaged with my feedback

records.segment: Australia-based SEO agency serving international clients
records.project_scope: Local SEO, backlinks, technical SEO, keyword targeting, frequent calls/texts/Zoom, and ongoing work.
records.buyer_job: Become visible to a local audience without needing to understand the technical work.
records.problem_or_friction: No material improvement requested; client stayed ongoing.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer reported first-page rankings in three months rather than the expected six months.
records.recommendation: Highly recommends and reports continuing the engagement.
records.quote_excerpt: We expected to rank ... in six months but made it in three months.

records.segment: local UK website and SEO agency
records.project_scope: New website and on-page local SEO.
records.buyer_job: Look professional, load quickly, and appear in local Google results.
records.problem_or_friction: No material complaint reported.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer said the site looked professional, loaded fast, and was already showing well on Google.
records.recommendation: Highly recommends.

records.spend_band: $1,490/month; reviewer says the agreement began July 2024 and was ended after an audit
records.project_scope: SEO retainer with monthly performance reports, backlink reports, bi-weekly fix reports, on-page fixes, content, and technical implementation.
records.buyer_job: Pay for substantive, compliant SEO work that improves the store and is visible in the client's platform.
records.problem_or_friction: Reviewer alleges hidden HTML text, stale counters, inaccessible or unshipped work, resold backlink output, missing keyword data, and reports largely repackaging the client's analytics.
records.reported_outcome: Reviewer says communication was responsive but the work did not match the payment and no user-visible content was published in the audited period.
records.recommendation: Advises asking for URL-level logs, a content publication plan, backlink provenance, and explicit confirmation that work is visible and compliant.
records.evidence_type: Trustpilot unprompted review updated by reviewer
records.quote_excerpt: communication was responsive, but the substance did not match what we were paying for
records.causality_status: allegation reported by reviewer; not independently verified

records.project_scope: Website design and ongoing development; exact deliverables not stated.
